recipe_inventory.label: Su et al. (1999): One-step ethanol solvothermal preparation at 160 °C for 10 h

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental, printed pp.110–111

recipe_inventory.scope: Quantified SnCl2·2H2O/yellow-P/KBH4 route; XRD, TEM and XPS of the as-prepared product. Single direct synthesis route.
gaps: Complete supplied four-page main read in text and visually, including Figures 1–3 and 20 printed references. No matching local SI was found in the bounded filename search; cited full sources and any unavailable SI are unreviewed.
Autoclave pressure, atmosphere, heating rate, cooling duration, stirring, filter specification, wash volume/count, vacuum pressure and isolated yield are not reported.

The source gives absolute ethanol at 90% of a 100 mL autoclave capacity; no independently measured 90 mL charge is asserted. Water of crystallization and proposed trace water are not a separate measured water addition.

The successful 160 °C/10 h route is quantitatively specified. Failed precursor/reductant/pre-reduction controls and qualitative temperature/time limits do not report complete separate charges or schedules.

The 20 nm Scherrer mean is distinct from the TEM observation that some particles are below 20 nm and larger features are aggregates. No TEM mean/distribution or measured atomic coordinates is supplied.

Yellow phosphorus is preserved as the source-named elemental charge, including its printed 7.74 mmol amount; no P4 molecular-mole conversion is inferred. The proposed reaction equation uses P4 separately.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.

source_notes.label: Proposed in-situ tin formation
source_notes.summary: The authors propose gradual reduction of Sn2+ by KBH4 to fresh active Sn, followed by reaction with yellow phosphorus. Gas generation and reduction are proposed to be limited in the sealed hot autoclave. This is a mechanism interpretation, not a measured gas-pressure or kinetic curve.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Mechanistic discussion and reaction scheme

source_notes.label: Solvent and water are distinct source claims
source_notes.summary: Absolute ethanol is the charged solvent. The discussion invokes trace water and ethanol/water mutual solubility when describing dissolved SnCl2·2H2O and KBH4; it does not prescribe a separate measured water addition to the reaction. Distilled water appears in the workup.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental and solvent discussion

source_notes.label: Crystallite, primary particle and aggregate scales
source_notes.summary: The 20 nm Scherrer mean is a diffraction coherence-size result. TEM shows some particles below 20 nm and larger aggregates; no TEM mean or uniform diameter is claimed. The measured cell constants differ from the literature comparison, which is retained separately.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Figures 1–2 and structure discussion

source_notes.label: Controls do not define extra complete recipes
source_notes.summary: Elemental-tin substitution, reductant omission and pre-reduction failed; low temperature or short time gave incomplete reaction and tin impurity. Higher temperature or longer duration gave larger grains. Exact separate specimen doses and schedules are missing, so these remain supporting observations.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2–3, Controls and temperature/time discussion

source_notes.label: Composition and adsorbed oxygen
source_notes.summary: The XPS Sn:P ratio is reported as 1.44:1 and described as close to Sn4P3. A small oxygen signal is attributed to surface adsorption. Neither is converted into a precise bulk nonstoichiometric formula or oxide fraction.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2–3, XPS discussion and Figure 3
